beforeSubmitPrompt.purpose: Prepend block-scoped atlas context (mission/kpi/depends/files) to the agent prompt.

afterFileEdit.purpose: Map the edited file to its owner block via files.md and append a 'cursor_edit' line to that block's checks.log.

beforeShellExecution.purpose: Reject shell commands that contradict /atlas/tech_stack.md or /atlas/rules.md (e.g., pip install when stack is React+Node).

stop.purpose: Recompute intelligence_health on session end so the dashboard is always fresh.
